scripts.deploy: node scripts/build-mastodon-web.mjs && pnpm -C packages/worker exec void deploy --backend cloudflare
scripts.test: vp -C packages/worker build && vp test run
scripts.types:worker: pnpm -C packages/worker exec wrangler types --env-interface Env
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm -C packages/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply tstodon --local
scripts.e2e:federation:all: tsx e2e/federation-smoke.ts && tsx e2e/federation-follow-create.ts && tsx e2e/federation-interactions.ts && tsx e2e/federation-delete-shared-inbox.ts && tsx e2e/federation-accept.ts
scripts.ci: vp check && vp -C packages/worker build && vp test run && pnpm -C packages/worker exec wrangler deploy --dry-run
